null_hypothesis: H0: the E19-derived offset formula does not produce a complete E15 VM execution that halts after IN,OUT,END with stdout byte 0x5a and final registers a=90,c=2,d=2.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: a full E15 VM using the frozen offsets executes the generated IN,OUT,END program and meets every registered state/output criterion.

required_vm_semantics.memory: materialized array of exactly 3^15 unsigned cells
required_vm_semantics.registers: a=c=d=0 initially; c and d advance modulo 3^15
required_vm_semantics.instructions: all eight canonical Malbolge opcodes implemented
required_vm_semantics.self_encryption: Classic printable-ASCII XLAT after each non-halting step

baseline: Run the same experimental VM at E10 and require byte/output/state parity with malbolge.py on the same generated source and input.
negative_control: Decode the frozen E15-generated source with offset[region0] changed from 0 to 1; require load-time INVALID rather than a false PASS.
claim_rule: VM_EXECUTION_PARITY_E15=DEMONSTRATED only if baseline, negative control, and every E15 success criterion pass. Otherwise NOT_DEMONSTRATED.
scope_exclusion: No claim for E11-E14 or E16-E18, quines, arbitrary programs, or canonical semantics beyond this registered VM profile.
